scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man climbs over the stone wall of a sheepfold while sheep gather behind a closed wooden gate in a sunlit rural landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates John 10:1's description of a person climbing into the sheepfold by another way instead of entering through the door, whom the verse calls a thief and a robber. The description follows the supplied Berean Interlinear token glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd carrying a crook steps through an open wooden door into a stone sheepfold, where sheep turn toward him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 10:2: the one entering by the door is the shepherd of the sheep. The sheepfold and surrounding setting are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A doorkeeper holds a wooden gate open while a shepherd turns and gestures to sheep following him out of a stone sheepfold.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 10:3: the doorkeeper opens for him, the sheep hear his voice, and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd glances back with an outstretched hand as sheep follow him along a sunlit hillside path, with a stone sheepfold behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of John 10:4: the shepherd goes ahead and the sheep follow, reflecting the verse's description of their knowing his voice.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler calls with an outstretched hand as a flock of sheep runs away across a golden, rocky hillside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 10:5: the sheep flee from a stranger whose voice they do not recognize.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, seated in a sunlit stone courtyard, gestures as a group of listeners watches him with questioning expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus speaking an allegory to listeners who do not understand what he is saying. The courtyard and gestures are artistic choices. The supplied Greek text is Nestle 1904 and the word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, wearing a cream robe and red cloak, speaks to listeners from the entrance of a stone sheepfold as sheep gather around him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene places Jesus in a sheepfold entrance to picture his words that he is the door of the sheep. The setting and the listeners' appearance are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Several sheep turn away inside a stone sheepfold as two men gesture over the wall in a sunlit pastoral landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the verse's sheep not listening to the thieves and robbers; the setting and figures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus welcomes a robed traveler at the open doorway of a stone sheepfold, gesturing toward a sunny green pasture where sheep graze.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Jesus' words that he is the door: whoever enters through him will be saved, will go in and out, and will find pasture. The traveler, sheepfold and landscape are artistic interpretations informed by the supplied Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a flower-filled garden and stream as a family gathers beside him; a cloaked thief carries a basket past uprooted plants in the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: Inspired by John 10:10 and its Berean Interlinear word glosses, this imagined garden contrasts the thief's destructive purpose with Jesus' coming so people may have life abundantly. The setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed shepherd spreads his arms before a flock of sheep on a rocky golden hillside, facing a wolf, with a village and mountains in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of Jesus as the good shepherd who lays down his life for the sheep. The wolf and the hillside are artistic details, not events specified in John 10:11.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A frightened man runs across a rocky, golden hillside, looking back as a wolf grabs a sheep by its fleece and the rest of the flock scatters.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 10:12: a hired servant leaves the sheep and flees as a wolf snatches and scatters them. The scene follows the supplied Greek text and Berean Interlinear token glosses; the landscape and appearances are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A hired shepherd sits under a tree counting coins from a pouch while sheep stand and graze nearby in a rocky pasture.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of the hired servant's lack of concern for the sheep in John 10:13. The coins, setting, and depicted action are artistic details rather than events stated in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree among sheep on a sunny hillside, holding a shepherd's staff and gently touching a sheep as they look at one another.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the good shepherd and his sheep recognizing one another, reflecting John 10:14's words about knowing his own and being known by them.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with outstretched arms before sheep in a stone fold, looking toward sunlight as a wolf approaches.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests Jesus' words about knowing the Father and laying down his life for the sheep. The sheepfold, wolf and sunlight are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd holding a crook reaches toward sheep approaching a stone fold, while more sheep gather around him beneath a tree in a sunlit hillside landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of the other sheep hearing the shepherd's call and gathering as one flock with one shepherd in John 10:16. The supplied word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a golden watercolor landscape, Jesus stands with a hand over his heart beside an open stone tomb; dawn lights a distant hill with an empty cross.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene responds to John 10:17, where Jesus says the Father loves him because he lays down his life so that he may take it again. The tomb, cross, and dawn are visual symbols, not a setting specified by the verse. The English token glosses used are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus kneels on a sunlit hillside, gently placing a lit oil lamp on a stone beneath a shaft of light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the lamp as a metaphor for Jesus' life. His hand rests on it as he lays it down, suggesting his willing choice and his authority to take it up again. The light from above suggests the command he received from the Father. The lamp and setting are not described in this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, two groups of people in ancient dress gesture and confer with thoughtful, concerned expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering reflects John 10:19's account of division arising again among Jewish people because of these words. The courtyard and individual reactions are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus sits speaking to a group as skeptical men gesture and other listeners look on.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined courtyard scene reflects John 10:20, where many say he has a demon and is insane and ask why others listen to him. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a group in robes listens as one man speaks and another points toward his eyes.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation illustrates people saying the words are not those of one possessed by a demon and asking whether a demon can open the eyes of the blind. The courtyard, people and gestures are artistic inventions. The excerpt identifies the English word glosses as Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Cloaked families carrying glowing oil lamps walk along a snow-dusted stone street, with a brightly lit temple complex in the distance beneath a cloudy winter sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: John 10:22 places the Feast of Dedication in Jerusalem in winter. The people, lamps, snow, and setting are imaginative details; the English word glosses used here are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks beneath a sunlit stone colonnade, with people behind him and a temple courtyard beyond the columns.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus walking in the temple, in Solomon's porch, as described in John 10:23. The architecture and other figures are artistic additions. The supplied English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands in cream robes as a group gathers around Him in a sunlit stone courtyard; a man gestures toward Him while others watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 10:24, in which people encircle Jesus and ask Him to tell them plainly whether He is the Christ. The setting and appearances are imagined. The excerpt's English word glosses come from the Berean Interlinear, not GBT-approved glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a group of listeners while taking the hand of a seated man beneath a tree, with sunlit stone buildings in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus answering listeners who do not believe; the gesture of helping a man suggests the works he says bear witness to him in his Father's name. The verse does not identify this particular act or setting.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus holds a shepherd's staff among a flock of sheep and gestures toward four reserved listeners on a sunny hillside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative pastoral scene uses the listeners' separation from the flock to picture Jesus' words that they do not believe because they are not among his sheep. The hillside and flock are visual metaphors, not a claim about the literal setting.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A shepherd in a red-brown cloak looks back and reaches toward a flock of sheep following him along a sunlit hillside path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative pastoral scene gives visual form to the verse's sheep hearing the speaker's voice, his knowing them, and their following him. The landscape and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of people rests among flowers in a giant cupped hand, beneath a golden sun with a river and hills in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a sheltering hand, light, and living greenery to evoke the eternal life and lasting protection promised in John 10:28.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with four people on a sunlit hillside as a vast luminous hand curves protectively around them and a dark hand reaches toward them from a distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene draws on the excerpt's Berean Interlinear word glosses: the luminous hand represents the Father's protection of those he has given to Jesus, beyond another's grasp. It is a visual metaphor, not a literal depiction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree on a rocky hillside, reaching one hand upward as golden rays illuminate a valley, a lake, and a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The light and landscape imaginatively suggest Jesus' statement that he and the Father are one; the verse does not describe these visual details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man in white and blue robes calmly faces a group of men, some holding stones aloft while one bends to pick one up.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of John 10:31: the Berean Interlinear token glosses describe the Jews taking up stones again so that they might stone him. The courtyard, clothing, expressions, and arrangement are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a group of men holding stones in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus asking which of the many good works he showed them from the Father is the reason they stone him; the setting and visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus faces several men, some holding stones, as one gestures toward Him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This is an imaginative depiction of John 10:33, where the speakers say they are not stoning Jesus for a good work but accuse Him of blasphemy, saying that He, being a man, makes Himself God. The setting and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward an open scroll while four men listen in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus answering his listeners and referring to what is written in their law, including the words 'I said, you are gods'; the setting, scroll and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Five people in ancient robes gather around an intact blank scroll on a stone table as an older man gestures in a sunlit courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the people whom the verse says were called gods and to whom the word of God came. The intact scroll symbolizes Scripture that cannot be broken; the setting and gathering are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Jesus speaks with one hand on his chest and the other extended while a seated man points at him and others listen.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 10:36: Jesus responds to an accusation of blasphemy, asking why they say this of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world because he said he is the Son of God. The supplied excerpt identifies its English word glosses as Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with open hands, speaking to five attentive listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined conversation reflects Jesus' conditional statement: if he does not do his Father's works, his listeners should not believe him. The setting and gestures are imaginative and are not specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus holds a seated man's hand in a sunlit stone courtyard while a group of onlookers watch, some skeptical and others hopeful.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined act of compassion and the courtyard setting illustrate the verse's invitation to believe Jesus' works and understand that the Father is in him and he is in the Father. The verse does not specify this particular act or setting. The interpretation follows the supplied Berean Interlinear glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks beyond the reach of several men stretching out their hands toward him in a sunlit stone courtyard.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 10:39: the supplied Berean Interlinear glosses describe their renewed attempt to seize him and his going out of their grasp. The courtyard and the figures' appearances are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man in simple robes sits beneath a tree beside a winding river, looking across the water toward reeds and sunlit hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative view of Jesus staying beyond the Jordan after returning to the place where John had first baptized. The setting and his appearance are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowd gathers around Jesus on a sunlit path, with several people speaking and gesturing as others listen among trees, flowers, and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts people coming to Jesus and speaking about John's testimony: John did no sign, and everything he said about Jesus was true. The setting and gestures are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree among a large crowd of men, women, and children who look toward Him, with hills, water, and a village in the sunlit distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of many people believing in Jesus there, as described in John 10:42. The setting, appearance, and gestures are artistic interpretation, not details specified by this verse.
